description: Doom E1M1 with Engine forward-only inspection and ordinary assist actions. Start the product with LOADING_BAY_LIVE_DEBUG=1.

controls.assist: Discover actions, telemetry, time and observer tools with playtest assist SESSION.
controls.keyboard: WASD movement, ControlLeft attack, E use, 1/2/3 weapon selection; click canvas for raw mouse look.

reset: All browser sessions share this native host world and time mode. Browser recovery does not reset gameplay; restart the owned product host for a fresh run. Observer camera/drawing are per browser.
